vue.notes: Regenerated fork of the 2022 xiaoxin-sky/tree-sitter-vue lineage (repo commits 2026-01-24: ABI 15, scanner UB and CRLF fixes; 2026-03-07: crate rename). crates.io 0.1.0 published 2026-03-07. MAINTENANCE RISK: single maintainer, 0 stars, 0 issues; it meets the criteria (commit within 24 months, not archived, builds and parses on tree-sitter 0.27) but the bus factor is one. Candidates were built one at a time (several grammar crates export the same C symbol, so linking two silently gives one grammar) and each parsed sample.vue and a stress file (v-for, v-model, #slot, v-if/v-else, script setup, scoped scss) with 0 ERROR nodes: tree-sitter-vue-next 0.1.0 (67 node kinds, ABI 15, chosen); arborium-vue 2.18.2 (MIT, bearcove/arborium bundle, 67 kinds, ABI 15, pulls arborium-html; the fallback if vue-next is abandoned); tree-sitter-vue-updated 0.1.0 (c-gamble fork of the 2022 grammar, 79 kinds, ABI 14: different kinds, detectors would need rechecking). Rejected: tree-sitter-vue 0.0.3 and tree-sitter-vue3 0.0.4 (2022, tree-sitter 0.20 API): linking them next to tree-sitter 0.27 fails (MSVC LNK2005 duplicate ts_* symbols; vue3 also LNK2019 unresolved tree_sitter_vue3). Embedding: v-html is a directive_attribute whose directive_name is v-html (sample line 3; stress lines 8 and 9); the word v-html in a comment or prose is ignored by the grammar. regexSinks are the fallback; they also match that comment and prose, hence the declared precision below 1 (declared, not measured on a corpus).

Embedding: {@html expr} is an html_tag node (sample line 6; stress lines 20 and 21; Svelte 5 file line 18). The word in a comment is ignored by the grammar but matched by regexSinks (declared precision, not measured on a corpus).

embedded-template.notes: tree-sitter org grammar for ERB, EJS and ETA. crates.io 0.25.0 published 2025-08-29; repo last commit 2025-08-31. Embedding: sample.html.erb and a stress file (comments, trim markers, blocks, <%==, raw(), .html_safe, sanitize) parse with 0 ERROR nodes. Directives are opaque code nodes: the raw( ) and .html_safe sinks are found by parsing all code nodes as one Ruby document (everything else blanked, so line numbers stay) with ast-grep patterns. The grammar cannot tell EJS <%- (raw output) from ERB <%- (whitespace trim): both are output_directive, so <%- is a sink only when the file name ends .ejs, which regexSinks cannot know (EJS <%- is not in the regex). <%== is Erubi raw output (sample line 2).

In this grammar a filter application is a binary_expression whose binary_operator is | (children: value, operator, name), so |safe is such an expression whose right operand is exactly safe (sample line 2; stress lines 15 and 16); {% autoescape false %} is an autoescape_statement holding a boolean_literal (sample line 3; stress line 17).
